annotations.title: Launch a study to real people

description: Use this only when the person explicitly says to launch a specific built study to real people: GatherHQ starts recruiting its audience and the interviews go live. This cannot be undone and uses the workspace's GatherHQ credits, so first tell the person who the study recruits and how many, and that it uses credits, and wait for their yes. Real people answer over time: follow it with gather_list_studies. Needs a workspace with GatherHQ credits. A study whose only audience is a manual link recruits nobody: when its design here named who to recruit, GatherHQ tries to set up that targeting first and does not launch if it can't. Some studies go to GatherHQ's team for review before they go live.

study_id.description: The study to launch (an id from gather_list_studies).
